summary: Polar Power, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into securities purchase agreements with CFI Capital LLC and Monroe Street Capital Partners, L.P. on May 21, 2026. The company issued convertible redeemable notes totaling $970,600 aggregate principal ($600,000 to CFI, $370,600 to Monroe), with net proceeds of approximately $807,100 after fees. The notes carry 6% interest, mature in 12 months, and are convertible into common stock at a discount to VWAP (80% of lowest 10-day VWAP, increasing to 65% of lowest trading price if delisted). No board recommendation or advisor named. The issuer reserves shares for conversion. Watch for dilution impact and NASDAQ listing status, which affects conversion terms.
